stackDivergence.rationale: Task145 replaces the incorrect scalar-only underline with original SvxTextLineItem enum/Color/ComplexColor value ownership and actual SvxUnderlineItem/SvxOverlineItem specializations. Reuse SfxEnumItem, Tools Color and docmodel ComplexColor; JS GC replaces native instance-manager/lifetime machinery. Defaults are NONE and COL_TRANSPARENT; independent copies retain all payloads; concrete-type/style/color/complex equality ignores Which. Native bool methods, unrestricted initialized enum value domain, signed16 style query, int32 style extraction, bool/Color/own-color member Any operations, alpha preservation and unknown-member untouched success are represented. Actual XComplexColor interface transport is explicitly unsupported (false), not a fabricated object/service; localized EditResId/GetColorString presentation remains unported. Existing browser no-argument style projection is retained as its established transfer boundary, without claiming full native transport. Canonical Tools FontLineStyle includes19LINESTYLE names and native size sentinel; all actual old enum users are migrated, with no duplicate enum or compatibility aliases. Real Calc underline104/overline105 defaults are witnessed without fabricating ScDocumentPool. Complete pool/document/connected UI/ODS and broader presentation/interface parity remain pending; intentional browser I/O/recovery choices preserved.
